amerrissage.title: Splashdown
amerrissage.narrator: Some missions begin with fireworks. This one begins with a drop of water on the ceiling.
amerrissage.text:
Your name is {{player}}. The Fableris Coalition sent you alone to **Narhex** — an ocean planet, no continents, wrapped in permanent night.

Somewhere under that black water: a **Halloween portal**, a forgotten relic. The only way out.

The capsule shudders. The hull breaches. The ocean rises.

An impact — brutal, deafening — slams you into the harness. Alarms scream three seconds, then die.

Silence.

Water is already at your ankles.

choices.text: Tear off the harness and reach the escape hatch
Check your suit and headlamp before moving

evasion.title: The hatch
evasion.narrator: When water rises, every second weighs the same.
evasion.text:
The manual hatch refuses once — twice — then gives way in a jet of ice-cold water.

You push out as the capsule tilts.

The fall lasts an eternity of two metres. The impact empties your lungs.

Narhex water is **black**. Not murky: **lightless**. Your headlamp flickers on — battery at 61%.

Above, the capsule sinks slowly, like an eye closing.

Below… nothing. Just the dark.

choices.text: Rise to the surface — catch your breath
Check the HUD — heading, depth, mothership beacon

eau_noire.title: Black water
eau_noire.narrator: At the surface, the sky is as black as the water. As if the planet refused daylight.
eau_noire.text:
You break the surface. The air smells of salt and burnt metal.

No horizon. No stars. A low cloud dome covers everything — sick orange light, distant, **like an extinguished pumpkin**.

Your HUD blinks:

**MOTHERSHIP — DERELICTA: 340 m · bearing 187° · target depth**

The radio crackles one syllable — then nothing.

*"—{{player}}? Can you he—"*

Static.

The water already pulls you down. Your suit is heavy. Your lamp, the only thing between you and nothing.

choices.text: Dive toward the beacon — without waiting
Call back on the radio — try to find the voice again

radio.title: Static
radio.narrator: A voice in the noise is sometimes worse than silence. Because you hope.
radio.text:
You hang in the cold water, mic open.

*"—{{player}}, if you hear me… don't surface. The portal isn't up there. Never up there. —"*

The voice tears apart. One word clings to the static:

*"…go down…"*

Then nothing.

Your HUD confirms: the **Derelicta** is **below** you. Far below.

Bubbles rise along your arm — yours, or something that passed without you seeing?

descente.title: Descent
descente.narrator: The deeper you go, the less you know if you're fleeing or chasing.
descente.text:
You dive.

At ten metres, the orange surface light becomes a memory.

At thirty metres, your lamp only catches particles — like snow falling **upward**.

At one hundred twenty metres, you **hear** the Derelicta before you see it: metal groaning under pressure, hull plates breathing.

An enormous mass takes shape in the cone of light — then exceeds it. Cracked hull. Broken antennas. Name half erased on the paint.

You only see a **fragment** of the hull. Imagination fills the rest.

choices.text: Swim along the hull toward a faint light breach

faisceau.title: The beam
faisceau.narrator: The most honest fear is the one that arrives when you decide to stop looking.
faisceau.text:
You light ahead.

Nothing. Black water. Metal walls covered in pale scum.

Battery: 47%.

You switch the lamp off to save power.

Darkness becomes **total**.

A heavy, wet rustle crosses the space where your beam just was.

Close enough to push water against your visor.

Far enough that you don't know **what**.

audace_vu.title: The passing shadow
audace_vu.narrator: Seeing is sometimes confirming what you didn't want to know.
audace_vu.text:
You switch on.

The beam sweeps the water — nothing.

Then, at the **edge** of the cone, movement: a smooth curve, wider than your whole ship, gliding silently into the dark.

You don't see the shape. You see the **absence** it leaves behind.

Your radio spits one second:

*"—Don't stare. Swim. —"*

The HUD marks a breach twelve metres away — faint orange light, **almost warm** in this cold.

lucidite_entendu.title: The second ping
lucidite_entendu.narrator: In the dark, the ear becomes more honest than the eye.
lucidite_entendu.text:
You don't move.

Your breathing makes steady bubbles — too steady.

A **ping** rises from the depths: the Derelicta's automatic sonar, still active.

Silence.

A **second ping** — closer — answers. Not the same tone. Not the same frequency.

Something is **listening**.

Then the sound moves away. Downward. Always down.

Your HUD overlays a route: the breach is **to your left**, off whatever-that-was's path.

You can reach it without turning the lamp on. Forty seconds of total darkness.

choices.text: Slide toward the breach in the dark

coque.title: The breach
coque.narrator: A dead ship sometimes keeps enough air for one living person.
coque.text:
You pass through the breach.

Water falls away — air pocket, pressure shift, ears ringing.

Your lamp sweeps a tilted hold: floating crates, cables like seaweed, **carved symbol** on a panel — stylised pumpkin, Fableris runes.

A terminal still blinks:

**PORTAL COORDINATES — SECTOR 7 — DEPTH 800 m**

The radio, one last time:

*"—{{player}}. Next episode: the cracked hull. Don't lose your light. —"*

Static. Then, very far away, a third ping.

choices.text: Copy the coordinates and prepare for what comes next

fin_epave.title: Still alive
fin_epave.narrator: On Narhex, surviving one night doesn't mean winning. Just continuing to go down.
fin_epave.text:
You save the coordinates. 800 metres. Sector 7.

Outside, the ocean presses against the hull — patient, immense.

You have air for a few hours. Light for less.

But you know where to go.

And somewhere, very far down, the Halloween portal pulses — invisible, orange, **hungry**.

**END EPISODE 1 — Splashdown**
